Fitted log-log model log10(mcap)=3.0247+0.5223*log10(TVL), R2 0.1939, residual SD 0.909; LOO MAE 0.6931 vs baseline 0.7667 (x1.11); walk-forward MAE 0.6789 vs 0.7979 (x1.18); conformal 80% x11.43; growth/maturity/category terms all hurt LOO and were dropped

Logistic launch odds on all 758 protocols: intercept -1.5305, coefs logTVL -0.0876, age +0.3145, growth -0.4308; in-sample AUC 0.617, 5-fold CV AUC 0.606; median odds 0.1505; top expected value Monarq $32.87

Rewrote lib/model.ts as radar-3: fitValuation (OLS + LOO hat-matrix + walk-forward + term tests + conformal), fitOdds (logistic + 5-fold CV), impliedValue with 80% interval, launchOdds, expected value = implied x odds x deposit/TVL, farmPlan with break-even-sized deposits $50-$2500 and $/hour verdicts, auditLedger for all 758 protocols

Rewrote dashboard app.js/app.css: KPI strip, live cover self-check (8 checks recomputed in the browser), Odds + Expected value columns with sorting, All 758 audit tab, model panel with fit/validation/term tests/odds/integrity, detail dialog widened to 880px with 2-column steps grid

Self-check showed Expected value recomputed 108/197: the dashboard used rounded odds while the model used full precision. Fixed by rounding odds to 4 decimals before computing expected value in lib/model.ts, so page and board agree to the cent
